intro: Illinois runs its elections through 108 local election authorities, mostly county clerks, with the State Board of Elections overseeing the state.

id_rule.text: To register in person, including during the grace period, bring two forms of ID, with at least one showing your current address.

src.label: Illinois State Board of Elections — FAQ

check.text: Check whether you are registered to vote in Illinois.
check.label: Am I registered?

elections.name: General election
elections.what: Federal, state and local offices, plus any statewide or local measures. Your exact ballot depends on where you live.

dates.label: Early voting
dates.detail: Early voting at your election authority's office starts Sept. 24. Permanent polling places for early voting open Oct. 19. Days and hours vary by local election authority.

src.label: Illinois State Board of Elections — election calendar

dates.label: Regular registration closes
dates.detail: This is the last day for regular registration with your election authority. After this you can still register during the grace period, which runs Oct. 7 to Nov. 3.

src.label: Illinois State Board of Elections — election calendar

dates.label: Grace period registration and voting
dates.detail: You can register or update your registration in person at your election authority or a site it sets up, and vote at the same time. Contact your election authority for locations.

src.label: Illinois State Board of Elections — election calendar

dates.label: Last day to register online
dates.detail: This is the last day to register through the State Board of Elections website.

src.label: Illinois State Board of Elections — election calendar

dates.label: Mail ballot application must be received
dates.detail: This is the last day for your election authority to receive a mailed application for a vote-by-mail ballot. You can apply in person until Nov. 2.

src.label: Illinois State Board of Elections — election calendar

dates.label: Election Day
dates.detail: Polls are open 6 am to 7 pm. Mail ballots postmarked by Election Day and received after the polls close can be counted through Nov. 17, the last day to finish counting them.

src.label: Illinois State Board of Elections — election calendar
